content: I become a transparent eyeball; I am nothing; I see all; the currents of the Universal Being circulate through me; I am part or parcel of God.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: In this famous mystical realization, Emerson describes the dissolution of the egoic boundary into pure witnessing consciousness, where the individual awakens as an integral organ of the living cosmos.
practicalInsight: Practice observing the world around you without labeling, judging, or inserting yourself into the center.
reflectionPrompt: What happens to your stress when you drop self-centered preoccupation and simply witness reality unfolding?
